OleGURPS.ExplosiveAmmo.P4Tandem: Tandem HEAT stages remain separate. Damage is cumulative without reactive armor; the GM resolves stage interactions and protection with reactive armor. Do not treat both stages as independent internal explosions.
OleGURPS.ExplosiveAmmo.P4Thermobaric: Thermobaric blast damage is divided by 2 x distance in yards. Native GGA Explosion uses 3 x distance and is not changed automatically; the GM must apply the correct divisor. Contact distance needs a separate ruling.

The underwater distance multiplier is already included for a confirmed Underwater Dart; do not multiply range again. Unknown depth or environment is not air. The GM checks reliability and platform restrictions against the saved conditions.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Impact: Apply primary damage in GGA: this load can cause serious injury. Check the offered major-wound/HT consequences; for knockback, use the yards and DX, Acrobatics, or Judo modifier shown by GGA. The GM resolves obstacles, movement, and conditions; do not repeat the same check.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Burst: Use the confirmed burst distance from the snapshot, then determine the burst point, sector, and affected participants from this load's source. Do not replace it with an HE sphere. Without these facts, neither detonation nor targets are established; do not add the native effect again.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Liquid: After the primary hit, determine where the confirmed liquid contacted and which protections prevent contact. Apply only the filler's documented consequences and ending condition; primary crushing damage is already calculated. Do not treat every filler as poison, smoke, or fire.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1TearGas: After confirming exposure and protection, roll HT-2 separately for coughing and HT-2 for temporary Blindness. Success on one check does not replace the other. The GM applies only failed-check consequences and ends them at their confirmed times.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1VomitingGas: After confirming exposure and protection, roll HT-2 separately for coughing and HT-2 for temporary Blindness, plus a separate HT-2 for retching. Success on one check does not replace another. The GM applies only failed-check consequences and ends them at their confirmed times.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1WPRemoval: To remove burning WP, use the DX check under HT172. Verify that the action is possible first; on success the GM records removal and stops the corresponding future intervals. Modifiers and action cost come from the source, not an automatic assumption.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Airburst: The confirmed Airburst bonus and numerical scatter on an applicable miss are already handled for this attack. Do not add the bonus again. TL5-6: +3 for an area or +1 for an air target; TL7-8: +4 for an area, without stacking channels. Scatter distance is the square of the failure margin from the snapshot, not a resolved burst point. Already-airburst Shrapnel, Beehive, and ABF do not gain a second effect.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1AirburstGeometr: Use the saved scatter distance to determine direction and burst height under the specific fuse and scene rules. Only then identify affected participants and distances from the center. A Damage button does not confirm the burst position. Without a source for direction, do not choose it automatically.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Incendiary: The inc modifier is already included in Damage. The GM checks HT175 and the material and circumstances to determine ignition; a label alone does not apply extra burning damage or a condition. Do not add another inc or extra damage dice.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1TracerIncendiar: Use the tracer-inc condition saved for this attack: it applies only within its half-damage range. If inc is absent from the completed profile, do not add it retroactively. Independent native I remains beyond half-damage range. The GM separately checks material and ignition conditions; no second inc or automatic burning is applied.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1TracerVisibilit: Determine who actually sees the tracer and the shooter's position. Give only those observers the information they are entitled to learn. Tracer alone does not reveal a hidden token to everyone; this card does not publish its coordinates, name, or ID.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1ERA: Before applying the shaped-charge component, verify ERA and its source's handling of this load. Set confirmed protection manually; unknown ERA is not absent ERA. Do not automatically select ordinary Explosion for the primary AD10 component: GGA then removes its divisor. Resolve external Linked separately.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1APHEX: Check whether this APHEX source describes incendiary effects. Kinetic, explosive, and fragment Damage are already available; the name alone does not imply new burning. If ignition is confirmed, resolve it separately for the material; do not add native inc again.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1HAFLASmoke: For confirmed Buck HAFLA DM34 under HT142, use smoke with a 7-yard radius for 1 minute. The GM determines the burst center, affected participants, and end time; the scene is not changed automatically. These values belong to DM34 and do not transfer to other WP. Repeated Damage does not create another cloud.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1ZeroDR: Enable the armor divisor in native Apply Damage. At original DR0, GGA already treats it as DR1; do not increase DR a second time.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Knockback: Damage and dkb have already been passed to GGA. Use native Apply Damage's knockback calculation; do not double it again or substitute the alternative Powers101 rule.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F1Shotgun:
B409: below one tenth of ½D, enable Shotgun in Apply Damage and enter the pellet count NP.
GGA scales damage and DR; do not add another multiplier.

OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Elements: Resolve each actual hit with its own target, location, Damage and DR in GGA. Do not multiply damage by element count or spend a cartridge per element. Do not repeat Hit. Rubber shot can also cause serious injury.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Allocation: One physical Buck-and-Ball charge: first actual hit is the ball, later hits are pellets. The source does not establish allocation across multiple charges. Native D remains ball damage; the GM resolves pellets.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Linked: Linked is a separate external component with its own defenses and hit conditions. Use saved native components; do not duplicate a published primary blast. Do not transfer carrier AD to Linked.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Internal: Internal Follow-Up requires confirmed carrier hit and penetration. Without penetration, an internal explosion is unconfirmed: resolve the original Follow-Up rule and defenses in GGA. Damage and repeated clicks do not confirm another explosion.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Fragments: Fragment Damage is one hit's damage, not Hit. Select a target, distance from center, posture, SM and cover. Enter an already completed native GGA 3d6 result; this section does not roll or create messages. Resolve locations and DR separately.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Tandem: No ERA: stages can accumulate. With ERA: resolve stages in order. Unknown ERA: no confirmed total. Do not apply both the sum and the stages; Linked remains separate.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Spall: HESH: when neither impact nor blast penetrates nonlaminated armor, spall is one tenth of maximum blast damage against DR/100. Round both up (HT170).
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Falloff: Thermobaric at r>0: floor(original Damage/(2×r)). Do not reduce twice or apply GGA Explosion /3r to the reduced value. Contact r=0 and unknown distances require separate adjudication. This result is not applied.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Reliability: SAPLE TL5–6: use a confirmed native 1d result, functioning on ≤ TL−2. TL7+ has no such check. Unknown results do not confirm an explosion; preserve the carrier strike. Repeated Damage does not require another 1d.
OleGURPS.AutomaticAmmo.F2Flight: Self-Destruct requires a specific fuse, sourced destruct distance and actual path. Do not substitute ½D. Reaching the distance creates no extra explosion or resource expense.
